Thanks Vanessa — tagging in a few technical notes so Acme knows what we're looking for.

Summary of what I see from the initial logs: the Coupa tenant is rejecting the assertion because the Audience field doesn't match the expected SP entity. Two likely causes:
1) Acme's IdP is sending the assertion with the wrong audience (their metadata points to a different entityID), or
2) Our portal config for that tenant is set to the production SP URL while the invite points to a per-tenant assertion consumer (relaystate) that wasn't registered.

What we need from Acme (minimal):
- IdP entityID (e.g., https://idp.acmecomponents.com/idp)
- IdP metadata XML (or URL)
- A screenshot of the assertion details if possible (we can accept a debug SAML response)

If you don't want to share the assertion publicly, we can set up a short webex/ssh session.

Workaround options I can implement quickly:
- Temporary tenant mapping: register the additional SP audience used by the invite (safe, low risk).
- One-time activation link (Vanessa mentioned) — I can generate this from the admin console. Saml handshake will remain broken but account will be active for PO operations.

I'll provision a one-time link unless Acme asks me to wait for their metadata. Creating SUP-2345 and assigning to infra-auth.
